content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Office buildings leased to corporate and government tenants, not self-storage units rented to consumers and small businesses."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family homes and mortgages; no storage facilities or storage rental business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Owns office buildings leased to corporate and government tenants; different property type and customers from self-storage."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retailer selling groceries and pharmacy goods; no storage rental business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Bowling and entertainment centers selling play time and food; a consumer leisure business, not storage rental."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants under long leases; different property type and tenants."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Logistics warehouse landlord leasing space to businesses; industrial real estate, not consumer self-storage."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment buildings plus securities investments; hospitality and residential rental, not storage."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Land developer with resorts, clubs and timber in Florida; differs in products, customers and business model from storage."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Rents uniforms and facility supplies to businesses via route service; a business service, not storage rental."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Lease-to-own retailer of furniture and electronics to credit-limited consumers; sells merchandise rather than storage space."}]}
